milestones.title: Canonical planning repository feed into Maxxed Admin
acceptance: Admin renders the exact planning source SHA and freshness
Planning and live execution state remain distinct and reconciled
Invalid or stale planning data cannot render as current

milestones.title: Accepted-output and owner-attention leverage telemetry
acceptance: Accepted output excludes failed, superseded and reverted work
Owner attention is not inferred from wall-clock time
Admin reports leverage with methodology and confidence coverage

milestones.title: Infrastructure budget and capacity governance
acceptance: GitHub hosted compute policy remains zero
Neon target is configurable at or below forty USD before scale-up
Fly.io prediction workload is excluded from engineering scaling
Capacity increases require measured bottleneck evidence

milestones.title: Portfolio critical-path scheduler and dynamic lane allocation
acceptance: Safe ready work fills available compatible lanes without owner assignment
Blocked high-priority work cannot starve independent ready work
Verification and repair congestion applies backpressure
Every dispatch is explainable from a captured policy/state snapshot

milestones.title: Governed product factories and shared-platform propagation
acceptance: WordPress, Android, web/SaaS, static-site and Unity factory contracts exist
Shared platform reuse reduces incremental bespoke effort
Architecture drift is detectable and routed into governed work

milestones.title: Legacy retirement and sustained end-state proof
acceptance: Superseded schedulers, queues and duplicate state authorities are removed
Chaos and recovery scenarios pass
Sustained accepted throughput is exception-driven and bottleneck-aware
